rationale: Launch-time caching only: QuickJS bytecode compiled at build time and embedded in the product binary (used only for its exact source SHA-256 and engine fingerprint, otherwise the script compiles from source as before) and ARMv8 SHA-2 acceleration of runtime::sha256 (identical digests, pinned by FIPS and block-boundary vectors). No design-import, Chromium, DesignIR, rendering, packaging or asset authority moves; rendered output is pixel-identical (Spectr native-shot Skia backend: 21 surfaces; probe GPU readback: 12/12 frames).
